summary: Partially completed frontend testing of enhanced chat message input features. Successfully analyzed code implementation and verified frontend accessibility, but encountered authentication barriers preventing full interactive testing of chat functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: Form validation not properly retaining field values after submission attempt

action_item_for_main_agent: Authentication system prevents full testing of chat features. Need to either: 1) Implement a test/demo user account with known credentials, 2) Add a demo mode that bypasses authentication for testing, or 3) Fix the signup form validation issues that prevent account creation. The enhanced chat components are properly implemented in code but require authentication access for interactive testing.

success_percentage.frontend: 60% (code structure verified, UI accessibility confirmed, but interactive chat features untested due to auth barrier)
